description: A classic higher-or-lower card game — guess the next card, build a streak, and beat your best.

faqs.a: A full 52-card deck, shuffled. Aces are high, ties count as wrong guesses.
Each correct guess adds 1 to your streak. The deck reshuffles automatically when it runs out.
A wrong guess (including ties) ends the round and shows your final score.
Yes — the remaining card count is shown so you know when a reshuffle is coming.
faqs.q: Can I see how many cards are left?

howto: Look at the current card and guess Higher or Lower.
Ties count as wrong — Aces are high.
Wrong guess ends the round — beat your best!
title: Higher or Lower Game
